title: Atlassian pre-placement talk
content: Atlassian will host a pre-placement talk in the main auditorium. Engineering leads will cover the interview process and the teams that are hiring. Attendance is mandatory for registered candidates.

title: Deutsche Bank shortlist published
content: The shortlist for the Technology Analyst internship has been published. Shortlisted candidates should check their application status and confirm their interview slot within 48 hours.

title: Zoho on-campus drive schedule released
content: The written test for Zoho's Member of Technical Staff role is scheduled for next week. Report to the venue thirty minutes early with your institute ID.

title: Qualcomm information session for E&M and CS branches
content: Qualcomm will run an information session covering the VLSI Design Engineer role ahead of the application deadline. Open to all eligible branches.

title: Fractal Analytics case study round released
content: The take-home case study for the Associate Data Scientist role has been emailed to all applicants. Submissions are due before the next round begins.

title: Amazon online assessment window closes soon
content: The online assessment window for both Amazon roles closes in two days. Complete both the coding and work simulation assessments before the deadline; partial submissions are not carried forward.

title: Cisco Network Engineer drive has concluded
content: The Cisco Network Engineer drive has concluded for this season. Final results have been communicated to candidates individually.

title: Resume verification closes this Friday
content: All final-year students must upload a verified resume before Friday. Applications submitted without a verified resume will not be forwarded to recruiters.

title: Updated placement policy for the current cycle
content: The one-offer policy remains in effect: once a student accepts an offer, all further applications are withdrawn automatically. Students who wish to sit for a dream company after accepting a first-round offer must request an exception in writing before the drive opens.

title: NOC requests: allow three working days
content: Off-campus offers and research placements require a No-Objection Certificate before you can accept. Submit the request through the portal at least three working days before you need a decision.

title: Mid-season placement statistics (draft)
content: Draft summary of offers made so far this season, broken down by branch and company, for internal review before it is published to students.
